children: 在战争和国内控制中运用强制手段，给武士带来两难。首先，在他们在所声称的领土内外制服对手方面越是成功，强制手段的持有者就越发现自己不得不管理所获得的土地、货物和人民；他们卷入资源的抽取，商品、服务和收入的分配，以及争端的裁决。但行政管理使他们偏离战争，并制造出有时不利于战争的利害关系。我们可以在基督徒武士历时五个世纪征服穆斯林西班牙的过程中看到这一两难。从1064年攻取科英布拉开始，标准的围攻做法是这样的：

The deployment of coercive means in war and domestic control presents warriors with two dilemmas. First, to the extent that they are successful in subduing their rivals outside or inside the territory they claim, the wielders of coercion find themselves obliged to administer the lands, goods, and people they acquire; they become involved in extraction of resources, distribution of goods, services, and income, and adjudication of disputes. But administration diverts them from war, and creates interests that sometimes tell against war. We can see the dilemma in the five-century conquest of Muslim Spain by Christian warriors. Starting with the taking of Coimbra in 1064, standard siege practice ran like this:
被围城镇的居民若及时投降，征服后可以留下，并保有全部自由。如果穆斯林在被围一段时间后才投降，他们只能带走自己能携带的财物。如果他们等到城镇被武力攻陷，就要面对死亡或奴役。（Powers 1988: 18）

Residents of a town under siege who surrendered promptly could remain with full freedoms after the conquest. If the Muslims surrendered after having been under siege for some time, they could leave with only those goods they could carry. If they waited for the town to fall by force, they faced death or enslavement. (Powers 1988: 18)
这三种回应中的任何一种都给征服者带来问题。第一种强加了——至少暂时地——建立平行统治制度的义务。第二种要求重新分配财产，并安置和管理一座人口锐减的城镇。第三种把奴隶留在胜利者手中，并更尖锐地提出重建生产与人口的挑战。无论以何种方式，征服都意味着行政管理。在更大的规模上，这些问题困扰着整个伊比利亚再征服。以不同的形式，它们标志着整个欧洲的征服史。

Any of the three responses set a problem for conquerors. The first imposed the obligation - at least temporarily - to establish a system of parallel rule. The second called for a redistribution of property as well as the settlement and administration of a depopulated town. The third left slaves in the hands of the victors, and posed even more sharply the challenge of reestablishing production and population. In one way or another, conquest entailed administration. On a larger scale, these problems dogged the whole reconquest of Iberia. In different forms, they marked the history of conquest throughout Europe.

第二个两难与第一个平行。战争准备，尤其是大规模的战争准备，不可避免地使统治者卷入抽取。它建立起征税、补给和行政管理的基础设施，这一基础设施需要自我维持，而且往往比它所服务的陆军和海军增长得更快；掌管这一基础设施的人获得自己的权力和利益；他们的利益和权力显著限制任何特定国家所能进行的战争的性质和强度。欧洲的蒙古和鞑靼国家通过劫掠和掠夺而不建立多少持久行政机构来解决这些两难，但它们的战略给其权力设置了内在限度，并最终使它们易受资金充足的大规模军队的攻击。相比之下，热那亚这类高度商业化的国家通过借用或外包抽取战争手段所需的机构来解决这些两难。在这两个极端之间，欧洲国家找到了若干其他方式来调和战争制造、抽取及其他主要活动的要求。

The second dilemma parallels the first. Preparation for war, especially on a large scale, involves rulers ineluctably in extraction. It builds up an infrastructure of taxation, supply, and administration that requires maintenance of itself and often grows faster than the armies and navies that it serves; those who run the infrastructure acquire power and interests of their own; their interests and power limit significantly the character and intensity of warfare any particular state can carry on. Europe's Mongol and Tatar states resolved the dilemmas by raiding and looting without building much durable administration, but their strategy put inherent limits on their power, and eventually made them vulnerable to well-financed mass armies. In contrast highly commercial states such as Genoa resolved the dilemmas by borrowing or contracting out the structure necessary to extract the means of war. Between the two extremes, European states found a number of other ways of reconciling the demands of warmaking, extraction, and other major activities.

事实上，欧洲国家在其突出活动和组织方面差异显著。在990年以后这一时期的主要阶段中，三种不同类型的国家都曾在欧洲各地增殖：征收贡赋的帝国；城邦和城市联盟这类主权碎裂的体系；以及民族国家。第一种建立了庞大的军事和抽取机器，但把大部分地方行政留给保留着巨大自主性的地区权力持有者。在主权碎裂的体系中，临时联盟和协商机构在战争与抽取中发挥重要作用，但在国家尺度上几乎没有出现持久的国家机器。民族国家把规模可观的军事、抽取、行政，有时甚至分配和生产组织联合在一个相对协调的中央结构之中。这三种类型全都长期存续并共存，这否证了把欧洲国家形成视为单一、单线过程的想法，也否证了把民族国家——它确实最终占了上风——视为一种内在地更为优越的政府形式的想法。

European states differed significantly, indeed, with respect to their salient activities and organizations. Three different types of state have all proliferated in various parts of Europe during major segments of the period since 990: tribute-taking empires; systems of fragmented sovereignty such as city-states and urban federations, and national states. The first built a large military and extractive apparatus, but left most local administration to regional powerholders who retained great autonomy. In systems of fragmented sovereignty, temporary coalitions and consultative institutions played significant parts in war and extraction, but little durable state apparatus emerged on a national scale. National states unite substantial military, extractive, administrative, and sometimes even distributive and productive organizations in a relatively coordinated central structure. The long survival and coexistence of all three types tells against any notion of European state formation as a single, unilinear process, or of the national state - which did, indeed, eventually prevail - as an inherently superior form of government.

若干世纪以来，征收贡赋的帝国一直主导着国家的世界史。帝国的出现主要是在强制手段积累相对较低而可得手段集中度较高的条件下。当皇帝以外的任何人积累了重要的强制手段，或皇帝丧失部署大规模强制的能力时，帝国往往解体。中华帝国尽管表面上具有巨大的持久性，却不断遭受叛乱、入侵和自治运动的困扰，并长期把预算的很大一部分用于向蒙古人和其他游牧掠夺者缴纳贡赋。欧洲的帝国也没有享有更大的稳定。例如，拿破仑1808年入侵伊比利亚半岛，粉碎了西班牙海外帝国的大部分。几个月内，西属拉丁美洲大部分地区便形成了独立运动，十年之内，该地区几乎全部裂解为独立国家。

Over the centuries, tribute-taking empires have dominated the world history of states. Empires appeared mainly under conditions of relatively low accumulation of coercive means with high concentration of the available means. When anyone other than the emperor accumulated important coercive means, or the emperor lost the ability to deploy massive coercion, empires often disintegrated. For all its appearance of massive durability, the Chinese Empire suffered incessantly from rebellions, invasions, and movements for autonomy, and long spent a major part of its budget on tribute to Mongols and other nomadic predators. Nor did Europe's empires enjoy greater stability. Napoleon's 1808 invasion of the Iberian peninsula, for instance, shattered much of the Spanish overseas empire. Within months, movements for independence formed in most of Spanish Latin America, and within ten years practically all of the region had broken into independent states.
联盟、城邦以及其他主权碎裂的安排，几乎在一切方面都与帝国不同。它们依赖于相对较高的强制积累和相对较低的强制集中；14世纪西欧广泛存在的城市民兵就是这种组合的典型。在这样的国家中，一个相对较小的名义臣民联盟就能与统治者的力量相当，而个人、群体和整个人口都有大量机会投向相互竞争的管辖机构。

Federations, city-states, and other arrangements of fragmented sovereignty differed from empires in almost every respect. They depended on relatively high accumulations, and relatively low concentrations, of coercion; the widespread urban militias of fourteenth-century western Europe typify that combination. In such states, a relatively small coalition of nominal subjects could equal the ruler's forces, while individuals, groups, and whole populations had abundant opportunities for defection to competing jurisdictions.

14世纪的普鲁士和波美拉尼亚提供了有说服力的对比：在当时由条顿骑士团统治的普鲁士，没有大诸侯能与骑士团的大团长匹敌，城镇也几乎没有权力。但骑士团安置的地主在其广阔的领地内拥有广泛的自由裁量权，只要岁入流向骑士团即可。在邻近的波美拉尼亚——一个由较小规模的德意志征服和联盟同时建立起来的公国——出现了许多与公爵对抗的武装对手，较小的领主索性从事公然的劫掠；与此同时，城镇支配了公国的等级会议，并在战时提供主要的军事力量。

Fourteenth-century Prussia and Pomerania offer a telling contrast: in Prussia, then dominated by the Teutonic Knights, no great princes rivalled the Knights' Grand Master, and towns wielded little power. But the landlords installed by the Knights had wide discretion within their own extensive domains, just so long as revenues flowed to the Knights. In nearby Pomerania, a duchy established simultaneously by smaller-scale German conquests and alliances, many armed rivals to the duke arose, and smaller lords took to outright banditry, as towns dominated the duchy's Estates and provided major military forces in time of war.
在1326—8年波美拉尼亚诸公爵与梅克伦堡之间的战争中，波美拉尼亚的城镇大体上站在其公爵一边，而贵族则与梅克伦堡结盟。当波美拉尼亚家族获胜时，城镇在其中有很大发言权的等级会议“获得了影响深远的特权：对年幼公爵的监护权、决定是否修建或拆毁公爵新城堡、以及在公爵违背承诺或侵害其臣民时另选新主的权利”（Carsten 1954: 90）。城市给予或拒绝支持的能力，赋予它们巨大的讨价还价能力。

During the 1326-8 war between the dukes of Pomerania and Mecklenburg, Pomerania's towns generally sided with their duke while nobles aligned themselves with Mecklenburg. When the Pomeranian house won, the Estates, in which the cities had much say, "were granted far-reaching privileges: the guardianship over minor dukes, the decision whether new ducal castles should be built or pulled down, the right to choose a new master if ever the duke broke his promises or wronged his subjects" (Carsten 1954: 90). The cities' ability to give or withhold support afforded them great bargaining power.

在征收贡赋的帝国与城邦之间，是民族国家——它们同其他国家一样围绕战争、国家制造和抽取而建构，但被关于臣民人口让渡强制手段的讨价还价所迫，大量投资于保护、裁决，有时甚至投资于生产和分配。普鲁士后来的历史说明了民族国家形成的过程。在14世纪，如我们所见，条顿骑士团在那里建立了一个中央集权的帝国。到15世纪，骑士团在瘟疫、农民外迁和军事失败的打击下开始解体，而他们先前控制的地区权贵本身成为普鲁士的政治势力。他们利用自己的权力对留在其庄园上的农民施加越来越大的限制；借助强制劳动，日益强大的地主转向自营地经营，并转向向西欧出口谷物。

In between tribute-taking empires and city-states stand national states - built around war, statemaking, and extraction like other states, but compelled by bargaining over the subject population's cession of coercive means to invest heavily in protection, adjudication, and sometimes even production and distribution. The later history of Prussia illustrates the process by which national states formed. During the fourteenth century, as we have seen, the Teutonic Knights established a centralized empire there. During the fifteenth century, the Knights, shaken by plague, out-migration of peasants, and military defeat, began to disintegrate, and the regional magnates they had previously controlled became Prussian political powers in their own right. They used their power to impose greater and greater restrictions on the peasants who remained on their estates; with coerced labor the increasingly powerful landlords shifted toward demesne farming and the export of grain to western Europe.

与此同时，勃兰登堡和波美拉尼亚的统治者先前因诸公爵与富裕市民的联盟而被削弱，此时开始在与城镇的无休止斗争中获胜，因为城镇在国际贸易中的地位下降，汉萨同盟代其斡旋的能力也减弱了。统治者于是必须与贵族主导的等级会议讨价还价，后者获得了为战争和王朝扩张授予——或拒绝授予——王室岁入的根本权力。在此后几个世纪里，勃兰登堡的霍亨索伦家族藩侯们一路奋战，在后来成为勃兰登堡—普鲁士的实体中取得卓越地位，在此过程中吸收了旧波美拉尼亚的大部分；他们缔结了婚姻和外交同盟，最终把领地扩展到相邻地区以及下莱茵河资本充裕的地区；他们还与贵族谈判达成协议，把特权和权力让渡给其本地区内的领主，但使君主能够获得常规岁入。

At the same time, the rulers of Brandenburg and Pomerania, previously weakened by alliances of their dukes with prosperous burghers, began to win their incessant struggles with the towns, as the towns' position in international trade declined and the ability of the Hanseatic League to intercede on their behalf weakened. The rulers then had to bargain with noble-dominated Estates, which acquired the fundamental power to grant - or deny - royal revenues for war and dynastic aggrandizement. Over the next few centuries the Hohenzollern margraves of Brandenburg fought their way to pre-eminence in what became Brandenburg-Prussia, absorbing much of old Pomerania in the process; they contracted marriage and diplomatic alliances that eventually expanded their domains into adjacent areas and into the capital-rich areas of the lower Rhine; and they negotiated agreements with their nobility that ceded privileges and powers to the lords within their own regions, but gave the monarch access to regular revenues.

从战役、谈判、条约和继承中，浮现出一个民族国家，在其中，普鲁士、勃兰登堡和波美拉尼亚的大地主在王室从未从他们手中夺走的领地内拥有巨大权力。在18世纪，腓特烈大帝这样的君主把这一结构的最后几块拼合到位，办法是把农民和领主一并纳入军队，一个归另一个指挥。普鲁士的军队模仿了乡村，贵族充任军官，自由农民充任军士，农奴充任普通士兵。农民和农奴付出了代价：许多农民沦为农奴，“在战时与平时，旧普鲁士的军事义务都削弱了农奴相对于贵族庄园的社会地位、法律权利和财产持有”（Busch 1962: 68）。在这方面，普鲁士走了一条与英国（农民成为农业雇佣工人）和法国（农民带着相当数量的财产存续到19世纪）不同的道路。但普鲁士、英国和法国都因君主与主要阶级之间围绕战争手段的斗争而震颤，并感受到由此产生的持久国家结构的创造。

Out of battles, negotiations, treaties, and inheritances emerged a national state in which the great landlords of Prussia, Brandenburg, and Pomerania had great power within domains the crown had never wrested from them. During the eighteenth century, such monarchs as Frederick the Great locked the last pieces of the structure into place by incorporating peasants and lords alike into the army, the one under the command of the other. Prussia's army mimicked the countryside, with nobles serving as officers, free peasants as sergeants, and serfs as ordinary soldiers. Peasants and serfs paid the price: many peasants fell into serfdom, and "In war and peace Old Prussia's military obligations weakened the social position, the legal rights, and the property holding of serfs vis a vis the noble estate" (Busch 1962: 68). In this respect, Prussia followed a different path from Great Britain (where peasants became rural wage-workers) and France (where peasants survived with a fair amount of property into the nineteenth century). But Prussia, Great Britain, and France all trembled with struggles between monarch and major classes over the means of war, and felt the consequent creation of durable state structure.
作为军事盟友和对手，普鲁士、英国和法国也塑造了彼此的命运。事理本身决定了民族国家总是彼此竞争，并通过与对手国家的对比获得自身认同；它们属于国家体系。国家结构主要类型之间的广泛差异在图1.7中被图式化。公元990年以后很久，这四种国家在欧洲不同地区都存在着充分发展的实例。成熟的帝国繁荣到17世纪，而主权碎裂的最后主要地带直到19世纪晚期才整合为民族国家。

As military allies and rivals, Prussia, Great Britain, and France also shaped each other's destinies. In the nature of the case, national states always appear in competition with each other, and gain their identities by contrast with rival states; they belong to
systems

of states. The broad differences among major types of state structure are schematized in figure 1.7. Well developed examples of all four kinds of state existed in different parts of Europe well after AD 990. Full-fledged empires flourished into the seventeenth century, and the last major zones of fragmented sovereignty only consolidated into national states late in the nineteenth.

children: 这三种类型的统治者面临一些共同的问题，但面临的方式不同。他们必然地把强制手段不均匀地分布于他们力图控制的领土。最常见的是，他们把武力集中在中心和边疆，试图通过次级强制集群、忠诚的地方强制持有者、巡游巡逻队以及广泛的情报收集，维持二者之间的权威。例如，奥斯曼帝国建立了两套相互重叠的体系，一套由卡扎（kazas）和其他民政管理单位组成，由卡迪（kadis）治理，另一套由桑贾克（sancaks）和其他封地骑兵区组成，由一名军事指挥官治理；在征服时期，军事体系往往吸收民政体系，代价是岁入的损失（Pitcher 1972: 124）。

Rulers of the three types faced some common problems, but faced them differently. Of necessity, they distributed means of coercion unevenly through the territories they sought to control. Most often they concentrated force at the center and at the frontiers, attempting to maintain their authority in between by means of secondary coercive clusters, loyal local wielders of coercion, roving patrols, and widespread collection of intelligence. The Ottoman Empire, for example, created two overlapping systems, one consisting of the
kazas
and other units of civil administration, governed by kadis, the other composed of
sancaks

and other districts of the feudal cavalry, governed by a military commander; in time of conquest, the military system tended to absorb the civilian, at the cost of losses in revenue (Pitcher 1972: 124).
然而，国家越大，强制的分布与资本的分布之间的差距越大，抵制中央控制的诱因就越强，国家的不同敌人在其领土内外结成联盟的诱因也越强。在19世纪奥斯曼塞尔维亚的贝尔格莱德桑贾克，为帝国效劳的显贵（avan）：

合乎逻辑地断定，与其仅仅充当再分配的管事，不如创建自己的再分配体系，这样更容易致富。他们夺取了农民生产的一份，对牲畜过境非法征收通行税，并截留了在萨瓦河和多瑙河集散地（尤其是贝尔格莱德）海关站所收费用的一部分，经由这些地方，塞雷斯和萨洛尼卡出口到维也纳和德国的棉花得以通过。特别是，他们主张自己对“德韦托”（deveto）的权利，这表面上是一种非法的贡赋，即在采邑骑兵（以向国家提供骑兵服务为条件）收取“德塞托”（deseto）即十分之一之后，再向农民收成征收的九分之一。通过这一行动以及其他针对人身或财产的暴力行为，从许多塞尔维亚农民那里征收的实物租赋骤然翻倍，有时甚至增至三倍。（Stoianovitch 1989: 262-3）

The larger the state and the greater the discrepancy between the distribution of coercion and that of capital, however, the stronger the incentives to resist central control, and for alliances to form among different enemies of the state, whether inside or outside its territory. In the
sancak
of Belgrade, part of nineteenth-century Ottoman Serbia, the empire-serving notables
(avan)

logically concluded that they could enrich themselves more easily by creating their own redistributive system than by serving simply as the stewards of redistribution. They seized a share in the production of the peasantry, levied illegal tolls on the passage of livestock, and retained a portion of the fees collected at the customs stations of the Sava and Danube entrepots, especially Belgrade, through which passed the cotton exports of Serres and Salonika destined for Vienna and Germany. In particular, they asserted their right to the
deveto,
ostensibly an illegal tribute of one-ninth of a peasant's harvest after the collection by the timariot (in return for cavalry service to the state) of the
deseto

or tenth. By this action and other acts of violence against person or property, the dues in kind exacted from many Serbian peasants were suddenly doubled, sometimes tripled. (Stoianovitch 1989: 262-3)
这种权力的下移在19世纪解体的奥斯曼帝国中广泛发生。但无论以何种版本，欧洲各地的间接统治代理人都面临效法其塞尔维亚表亲的诱惑。考虑到通讯的成本，以及王室地区代理人通过逃避来自中心的要求、或把受委托的国家手段用于地方或个人目的所能获得的利益，所有统治者都面临对其霸权的反复挑战。

This sort of devolution of power occurred widely in the disintegrating Ottoman Empire of the nineteenth century. But in one version or another, agents of indirect rule everywhere in Europe faced temptations to emulate their Serbian cousins. Given the costs of communication and the advantages regional agents of the crown could gain by evading demands from the center or by using delegated national means for local or individual ends, all rulers faced repeated challenges to their hegemony.

帝国的统治者通常设法笼络地方和地区权力持有者，而不彻底改造其权力基础，并创建一支独特的王室仆从队伍——往往是现在或过去的战友——其命运取决于王室的命运。举一个极端的例子，马穆鲁克苏丹维持着一整个由沦为奴隶的外国人组成的阶层，这些人成为武士和行政官员；然而，除了直接供养官员的封地之外，马穆鲁克让地方权贵在其领地内留任。借助这样的制度，奴隶们实际上从1260年到1517年统治着埃及和中东邻近地区（Garcin 1988）。民族国家的统治者通常更努力地建立完整的行政等级体系，并消除自主的权力基础。例如，勃兰登堡—普鲁士的选帝侯和国王把巨大权力让渡给拥有土地的容克，但通过官职、免税和兵役把他们紧紧束缚于王室。

Rulers of empires generally sought to co-opt local and regional powerholders without utterly transforming their bases of power and to create a distinctive corps of royal servants - often present or former comrades in arms - whose fate depended on that of the crown. Mamluk. sultans, to take an extreme case, maintained a whole caste of enslaved foreigners who became warriors and administrators; except for fiefs directly supporting officials, however, the Mamluks left local magnates in place within their domains. With such a system, slaves actually ruled Egypt and adjacent areas of the Middle East from 1260 to 1517 (Garcin 1988). Rulers of national states usually tried harder to create a complete administrative hierarchy and to eliminate autonomous bases of power. The Electors and kings of Brandenburg-Prussia, for example, ceded great power to the landholding Junkers, but tied them closely to the crown by means of offices, tax exemptions, and military service.
在城邦、联盟以及其他主权碎裂的国家中统治或自称统治的人，往往设法对单个城市及其紧邻腹地实施严密控制。然而，超出这一规模，他们别无选择，只能与竞争中心的当局讨价还价。地方控制通常不仅取决于城市的强制力量，也取决于城市统治阶级广泛的乡村土地持有。一旦佛罗伦萨在14世纪开始其超越市政层面的侵略性扩张，其僭主便尽可能用自己的人取代被征服城市的统治者，但这些替代者是从当地贵族中挑选的。

Those who ruled, or claimed to rule, in city-states, federations, and other states of fragmented sovereignty often managed to exercise tight control over a single city and its immediate hinterland. Beyond that scale, however, they had no choice but to bargain with the authorities of competing centers. The local control usually depended not only on the city's coercive forces, but also on extensive rural landholding by the urban ruling class. Once Florence began its aggressive expansion beyond the municipal level during the fourteenth century, its tyrants replaced the rulers of conquered cities with their own men as much as possible, but selected the replacements from among the local patricians.
所有这些安排都把相当大的权力和自由裁量权留在地方权贵手中，只要他们遏制君主的敌人并让岁入流向国家首都。事实上，在国家尺度上，直到法国大革命时代，没有任何欧洲国家（也许瑞典除外）认真尝试自上而下地实行直接统治。在此之前，除最小的国家外，所有国家都依赖某种版本的间接统治，因而承担着不忠、伪装、腐败和叛乱的严重风险。但间接统治使统治成为可能，而无需建立、资助和供养一个庞大的行政机器。

All these arrangements left considerable power and discretion in the hands of local potentates, just so long as they contained the monarch's enemies and kept the revenues flowing to the national capital. On a national scale, in fact, no European state (except, perhaps, Sweden) made a serious attempt to institute direct rule from top to bottom until the era of the French Revolution. Before then all but the smallest states relied on some version of indirect rule, and thus ran serious risks of disloyalty, dissimulation, corruption, and rebellion. But indirect rule made it possible to govern without erecting, financing, and feeding a bulky administrative apparatus.
向直接统治的转变，使统治者通过户税、大规模征兵、人口普查、警察系统以及许多其他对小规模社会生活的侵入，得以接触公民及其控制的资源。但这一转变是在广泛抵抗、大量讨价还价以及为公民创造权利和特权的代价下实现的。这种渗透和讨价还价都奠定了新的国家结构，使政府的预算、人员和机构图膨胀。我们时代那个无所不食的国家由此成形。

The transition to direct rule gave rulers access to citizens and the resources they controlled through household taxation, mass conscription, censuses, police systems, and many other invasions of small-scale social life. But it did so at the cost of widespread resistance, extensive bargaining, and the creation of rights and perquisites for citizens. Both the penetration and the bargaining laid down new state structures, inflating the government's budgets, personnel, and organizational diagrams. The omnivorous state of our own time took shape.
把国家形成当作一种工程，把国王及其大臣当作设计工程师，这是再容易不过的。但有四个事实损害了这一自信规划的形象。
It is all too easy to treat the formation of states as a type of engineering, with kings and their ministers as the designing engineers. Four facts compromise the image of confident planning.

欧洲的君主们很少对他们在制造的那种国家怀有精确的模型，他们更少能有效地行动以制造出这样的典范国家。例如，当诺曼人罗杰·德·欧特维尔在1060年至1075年间从阿拉伯人控制下夺取西西里时，他通过吸收现有穆斯林行政机构的若干部分来临时拼凑政府，把穆斯林士兵引入自己的军队，并维持穆斯林、犹太人和希腊基督徒各自的宗教机构，但把大片土地据为自己的领地，把其他土地分封给追随者。属于西西里的卡拉布里亚在文化和政治风格上仍非常希腊化，拜占庭的官职和礼仪被整体引入诺曼政府。但阿拉伯制度也有其位置：罗杰的首席大臣拥有一个绝妙的头衔——“众埃米尔之埃米尔与众执政官之执政官”。由此产生的国家确实独特而新颖，但它并非源自一个连贯的计划。罗杰·德·欧特维尔及其追随者创造了一幅由适应与即兴拼成的马赛克（Mack Smith 1968a: 15-25）。

Rarely did Europe's princes have in mind a precise model of the sort of state they were producing, and even more rarely did they act efficiently to produce such a model state. As the Norman Roger de Hauteville wrested Sicily from Arab control between 1060 and 1075, for example, he improvised a government by incorporating segments of the existing Muslim administration, drew Muslim soldiers into his own army, and maintained Muslim, Jewish, and Greek Christian churches, but took over large tracts of land as his own domain and parceled out other lands to his followers. Calabria, which belonged to Sicily, remained very Greek in culture and political style, with Byzantine offices and rituals brought wholesale into Norman government. But Arab institutions also had their place: Roger's chief minister bore the wonderful title Emir of Emirs and Archonte of Archontes. The resulting state was certainly distinctive and new, but it did not emanate from a coherent plan. Roger de Hauteville and his followers created a mosaic of adaptations and improvisations (Mack Smith 1968a: 15-25).

没有人设计民族国家的主要组成部分——国库、法院、中央行政机构等等。它们通常作为旨在完成更直接任务的努力——尤其是武装力量的创建和维持——的或多或少无意的副产品而形成。当法国王室在1630年代大幅扩大其对欧洲战争的介入，把信贷扩张到破产的地步时，国王的大臣们通常依靠来征收岁入的地方当局和官职持有者停止了合作。此时，首席大臣黎塞留绝望之下开始派出自己的代理人去强制或绕过地方当局（Collins 1988）。这些使者就是王室监察官，他们在柯尔贝尔和路易十四治下成为法国各地区国家权威的支柱。只有在错误的回溯中，我们才把监察官想象为绝对主义刻意设计的工具。

No one designed the principal components of national states - treasuries, courts, central administrations, and so on. They usually formed as more or less inadvertent by-products of efforts to carry out more immediate tasks, especially the creation and support of armed force. When the French crown, greatly expanding its involvement in European wars during the 1630s, stretched its credit to the point of bankruptcy, the local authorities and officeholders on whom the king's ministers ordinarily relied for the collection of revenues ceased cooperating. At that point chief minister Richelieu, in desperation, began sending out his own agents to coerce or bypass local authorities (Collins 1988). Those emissaries were the royal intendants, who became the mainstays of state authority in French regions under Colbert and Louis XIV. Only in faulty retrospect do we imagine the intendants as deliberately designed instruments of Absolutism.

其他国家——最终是整个国家体系——强烈影响任何特定国家所遵循的变化路径。从1066年到1815年，与法国君主的大战塑造了英国国家；法国的干预使英国试图制服苏格兰和爱尔兰的努力复杂化；法国的竞争刺激英国采纳荷兰的财政创新。从16世纪起，重大战争的战后安排一再调整欧洲国家的边界和统治者，直到第二次世界大战仍是如此；德国的分裂，爱沙尼亚、拉脱维亚和立陶宛并入苏联，以及大多数欧洲海外帝国的拆解，都或多或少直接源于第二次世界大战后的安排。在这些情况中，我们都不能合理地设想一个自我引导、自行行动的国家。

Other states - and eventually the entire system of states - strongly affected the path of change followed by any particular state. From 1066 to 1815, great wars with French monarchs formed the English state, French intervention complicated England's attempts to subdue Scotland and Ireland, and French competition stimulated England's adoption of Dutch fiscal innovations. From the sixteenth century onward, settlements of major wars regularly realigned the boundaries and the rulers of European states, right up to World War II; the division of Germany, the incorporation of Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania into the Soviet Union, and the dismantling of most European overseas empires all stemmed more or less directly from the settlements of World War II. In none of these cases can we reasonably think of a self-guided state acting on its own.

与臣民人口中不同阶级的斗争和讨价还价，显著塑造了在欧洲出现的国家。例如，民众叛乱通常失败，但每一次重大叛乱都以镇压政策、阶级为支持或反对国家而重新组合，以及明确规定受影响各方权利的正式解决等形式，在国家身上留下印记。在1378年佛罗伦萨工人（梳毛工，Ciompi）的激烈起义中，叛乱期间组成的三个新毛纺工行会中有两个倒向政府，从而摧毁了曾在该城夺取实际权力的阵线；在最终的解决中，仍在起义的（也更无产阶级的）那个行会丧失了存在的权利，而两个合作者则加入了作为官方市政政府一部分游行和议事的行会（Schevill 1963: 279; Cohn 1980: 129-54）。

Struggle and bargaining with different classes in the subject population significantly shaped the states that emerged in Europe. Popular rebellions, for example, usually lost, but each major one left marks on the state in the form of repressive policies, realignments of classes for or against the state, and explicit settlements specifying the rights of the affected parties. During the fierce revolt of the Florentine workers (the Ciompi) in 1378, two of the three new woolworkers' guilds formed during the rebellion defected to the government and thereby destroyed a front that had seized effective power in the city; in the settlement, the still-insurrectionary (and more proletarian) guild lost its right to exist, but the two collaborators joined the guilds that paraded and deliberated as part of the official municipal government (Schevill 1963: 279; Cohn 1980: 129-54).
在更小的规模上，骑士、金融家、市政官员、地主、农民、工匠及其他行动者的抵抗与合作，长期创造并再创造着国家结构。因此，落入某一特定国家管辖权下人口的阶级结构，显著影响该国的组织，而欧洲各地阶级结构的差异造成了国家性质上系统性的地理差异。不仅是统治阶级，而且所有其资源和活动影响战争准备的阶级，都在欧洲国家身上留下了印记。

On a smaller scale, both the resistance and the cooperation of knights, financiers, municipal officers, landlords, peasants, artisans, and other actors created and recreated state structure over the long run. Thus the class structure of the population that fell under the jurisdiction of a particular state significantly affected the organization of that state, and variations in class structure from one part of Europe to another produced systematic geographic differences in the character of states. Not only the ruling classes, but all classes whose resources and activities affected preparation for war, left their imprint on European states.

例如，两个事实强烈影响了瑞典国家形成的路径：第一，农民阶层的压倒性存在，他们直到18世纪仍持有大量土地；第二，地主相对无力组建大庄园或在土地上强制农民劳动。这种独特的乡村阶级结构，阻止了那种王室策略：授予贵族财政和司法特权，并协助他们迫使农民服从其意志，以换取贵族在从农民那里抽取岁入和兵役方面的合作——尽管这种策略在普鲁士和俄国等邻近地区盛行。它也有助于解释一个独立的农民等级何以存续，该等级实际上对政府行动拥有某些权力；并有助于解释这一事实：在其帝国扩张时期，瑞典迅速从在欧洲市场上雇佣雇佣兵转向建立民兵，其成员通过服役获得土地或土地收益。在瑞典如同在其他地方，周围的阶级结构约束了统治者创建武装力量的尝试，从而对国家组织本身留下了影响。

Twin facts, for example, strongly affected the path of Swedish state formation: first, the overwhelming presence of a peasantry that held plenty of land well into the eighteenth century; second, the relative inability of landlords either to form great estates or to coerce peasant labor on their lands. That exceptional rural class structure prevented the royal strategy of granting nobles fiscal and judicial privileges and assistance in bending peasants to their will in return for collaboration in extracting revenues and military service from the peasantry - even though such a strategy prevailed in nearby areas such as Prussia and Russia. It also helps explain the survival of a separate peasant Estate which actually had some power over governmental action, and the fact that in its period of imperial expansion Sweden turned rapidly from the hiring of mercenaries on the European market to the creation of militias whose members received land, or the income from land, in return for their service. In Sweden as elsewhere, the ambient class structure constrained rulers' attempts to create armed force, and therefore left its impact on the very organization of the state.

body.readingText: Relations among coercion, capital, states, and cities.

children: 图1.8对根本关系作了更一般、更图式化的陈述。该图之所以呈现这种形状，原因我们在前面已作考察：战争和战争准备使统治者不得不从其他人那里抽取战争手段——从那些掌握必要资源（人力、武器、补给或购买它们的金钱）并且在没有强大压力或补偿时不愿交出的人那里。国家领土内主要社会阶级的组织及其与国家的关系，显著影响统治者抽取资源所采用的策略、他们遭遇的抵抗、由此产生的斗争、抽取与斗争所留下的持久组织类型，从而影响资源抽取的效率。在其他国家的要求与报偿所设定的限度内，对战争手段的抽取和争夺造就了国家的核心组织结构。主要社会阶级的组织及其与国家的关系，从欧洲的强制密集型地区（城市稀少、农业占主导、直接强制在生产中起重大作用的地区）到其资本密集型地区（城市众多、商业占主导、市场、交换和面向市场的生产盛行的地区），差异显著。主要阶级对国家提出的要求及其对国家的影响力，也相应地变化。因此，不同抽取策略的相对成功以及统治者实际采用的策略，从强制密集型地区到资本密集型地区差异显著。其结果是，国家的组织形式在欧洲这些不同地区遵循明显不同的轨迹。这种情况否证了任何这样的想法：欧洲君主只是采纳了一个看得见的国家形成模型，并尽力效仿它。

A more general and schematic statement of the essential relationships is given in figure 1.8. The diagram takes this shape for the reasons we surveyed earlier: war and preparation for war involved rulers in extracting the means of war from others who held the essential resources - men, arms, supplies, or money to buy them - and were reluctant to surrender them without strong pressure or compensation. The organization of major social classes within a state's territory, and their relations to the state, significantly affected the strategies rulers employed to extract resources, the resistance they met, the struggle that resulted, the sorts of durable organization extraction and struggle laid down, and therefore the efficiency of resource extraction. Within limits set by the demands and rewards of other states, extraction and struggle over the means of war created the central organizational structures of states. The organization of major social classes, and their relations to the state varied significantly from Europe's coercion-intensive regions (areas of few cities and agricultural predominance, where direct coercion played a major part in production) to its capital-intensive regions (areas of many cities and commercial predominance, where markets, exchange, and market-oriented production prevailed). Demands major classes made on the state, and the influence of those classes over the state, varied correspondingly. The relative success of different extractive strategies, and the strategies rulers actually applied, therefore varied significantly from coercion-intensive to capital-intensive regions. As a consequence, the organizational forms of states followed distinctly different trajectories in these different parts of Europe. Such circumstances belie any idea that European monarchs simply adopted a visible model of state formation and did their best to follow it.

另一个幻象也必须消失。到目前为止，我把这些关系呈现得仿佛资本和强制总是走向更大的积累和集中。对我们在此关注的一千年而言，这些确实是主要趋势。然而，即便在欧洲经验之内，许多国家也在这两个方面经历了收缩；波兰在资本和强制上都经历了许多逆转，相继的勃艮第和哈布斯堡帝国崩溃，16世纪的宗教战争严重耗竭了欧洲的资本和强制手段储备。欧洲国家形成的历史总体上是向上走向更大的积累和集中，但它穿越的是参差的峰峦和深谷。

Another illusion must also disappear. So far I have presented the relationships as though capital and coercion always moved toward greater accumulation and concentration. For the thousand years that concern us here, those have been the main trends. Yet even within the European experience many states have undergone deflation in both regards; Poland endured many reversals in capital and coercion, successive Burgundian and Habsburg empires collapsed, and the sixteenth-century religious wars seriously depleted Europe's stocks of capital and coercive means. The history of European state formation runs generally upward toward greater accumulation and concentration, but it runs across jagged peaks and profound valleys.

积累可能对欧洲经济的历史造成了更大的长期差异。但强制的集中、分散和再集中标志着国家形成故事的主要篇章；集中又在重要程度上依赖于集中资本的可得性。究竟为何如此、如何如此，将是本书后面各节关注的问题，并会把我们带入复杂的财政政策问题。然而，核心的联系很简单：从长远看，战争和战争准备比其他活动远为更多地造就了欧洲国家的主要组成部分。战败的国家通常收缩，并往往不复存在。无论规模大小，拥有最大强制手段的国家倾向于赢得战争；效率（产出与投入之比）次于效力（总产出）。

Accumulation probably made the larger long-term difference to the history of the European economy. But concentration, deconcentration, and reconcentration of coercion mark off major chapters in the story of state formation; the concentration came to depend in important degree on the availability of concentrated capital. Exactly why and how that was so will preoccupy this book's later sections and take us into complicated questions of fiscal policy. Yet the central link is simple: over the long run, far more than other activities, war and preparation for war produced the major components of European states. States that lost wars commonly contracted, and often ceased to exist. Regardless of their size, states having the largest coercive means tended to win wars; efficiency (the ratio of output to input) came second to effectiveness (total output).
通过竞争、技术变革以及最大交战国家规模的相互作用，战争和强制手段的创造随着时间推移变得极其昂贵。随着这种情况发生，越来越少有统治者能从自己常规的资源中创造军事手段；他们越来越多地转向短期借贷和长期征税。这两种活动在资本集中已经存在的地方都更容易进行。但它们到处都带来了政府组织的变化。

Through the interplay of competition, technological change, and the sheer scale of the largest belligerent states, war and the creation of coercive means became immensely more expensive over time. As that happened, fewer and fewer rulers could create military means from their own routine resources; more and more they turned to short-term borrowing and long-term taxation. Both activities went more easily where concentrations of capital already existed. But everywhere they produced changes in governmental organization.
战争和国家组织的变化如何相互关联？作为初步的近似，我们可以把公元990年以来的年代划分为四个阶段，其时间界限在欧洲各地有所不同：

How did changes in warfare and state organization relate to each other? As a first approximation, we can divide the years since AD 990 into four segments, with varying temporal limits from one part of Europe to another:
家产制：在这一时期（在欧洲大部分地区直到15世纪），部落、封建征召兵、城市民兵以及类似的习惯性武力在战争中起主要作用，君主一般从处于其直接控制下的土地和人口中以贡赋或地租的形式抽取所需的资本；
经纪：在这一时代（在欧洲重要地区大致为1400年至1700年），由承包商招募的雇佣军力量在军事活动中占主导，统治者严重依赖形式上独立的资本家提供贷款、管理产生岁入的企业，以及设置和征收赋税；
patrimonialism:

a time (up to the fifteenth century in much of Europe) when tribes, feudal levies, urban militias, and similar customary forces played the major part in warfare, and monarchs generally extracted what capital they needed as tribute or rent from lands and populations that lay under their immediate control;
brokerage:

an era (roughly 1400 to 1700 in important parts of Europe) when mercenary forces recruited by contractors predominated in military activity, and rulers relied heavily on formally independent capitalists for loans, for management of revenue-producing enterprises, and for installation and collection of taxes;
国家化：这一时期（在欧洲大部分地区尤其是1700年至约1850年），国家建立大规模陆军和海军，其兵员越来越多地来自本国国民人口，同时君主把武装力量直接吸纳入国家的行政结构，并同样接管财政机构的直接运作，大幅削减独立承包商的参与；
nationalization:

a period (especially 1700 to 1850 or so in much of Europe) when states created mass armies and navies drawn increasingly from their own national populations, while sovereigns absorbed armed forces directly into the state's administrative structure, and similarly took over the direct operation of the fiscal apparatus, drastically curtailing the involvement of independent contractors;
专业化：这一时代（大约从19世纪中叶到最近过去），军事力量成长为中央政府中一个强大的专门分支，财政活动与军事活动的组织分离加深，军队与警察之间的分工更趋分明，代议机构对军事支出开始具有显著影响，国家承担了范围大为扩展的分配、规制、补偿和裁决活动。
specialization:

an age (from approximately the mid-nineteenth century to the recent past) in which military force grew as a powerful specialized branch of national government, the organizational separation of fiscal from military activity increased, the division of labor between armies and police sharpened, representative institutions came to have a significant influence over military expenditures, and states took on a greatly expanded range of distributive, regulatory, compensatory, and adjudicative activities.
显然，资本与强制之间的关系从一个时期到下一个时期发生了显著变化。
Clearly the relations between capital and coercion changed significantly from one period to the next.

战争对国家造成的转型，反过来也改变了战争的赌注。在家产制时期，征服者追求贡赋远甚于追求对所占领土内人口和资源的稳定控制；整个帝国都建立在这样的原则之上：从多个地区的统治者那里抽取地租和礼物，而不深入渗透其统治体系。在向经纪制、然后向国家化的转变中，一个严密管理的领土成为值得为之战斗的资产，因为只有这样的领土才提供维持武装力量的岁入。但在专业化时代，国家如此迅速地积累起对其服务的索取者，以至于战争变得比以往更是通过获取其他国家资源来满足统治联盟经济利益的手段。第二次世界大战以来，随着欧洲国家体系扩展到整个世界以及随之而来的国家边界的僵化，这越来越意味着对其他国家施加影响，而不实际把其领土并入更强大国家的领土。

The transformation of states by war, in its turn, altered the stakes of war. Through the period of patrimonialism, conquerors sought tribute much more than they sought the stable control of the population and resources within the territories they overran; whole empires grew up on the principle of extracting rents and gifts from the rulers of multiple regions without penetrating significantly into their systems of rule. In the move to brokerage and then to nationalization, a closely administered territory became an asset worth fighting for, since only such a territory provided the revenues to sustain armed force. But in the age of specialization, states accumulated claimants to their services so rapidly that war became, even more than before, a means of satisfying the economic interests of the ruling coalition by gaining access to the resources of other states. Since World War II, with the extension of the European state system to the entire world and the accompanying rigidification of national boundaries, that has increasingly meant exercising influence over other states without actually incorporating their territory into that of the more powerful state.

这些就是大的趋势。然而，在欧洲国家成长的每个阶段，都出现了不止一种资本与强制的组合。我们可以区分出国家形成的强制密集型、资本密集型和资本化强制三条路径。它们与其说代表可供选择的“战略”，不如说代表对照鲜明的生活条件。在极为不同的环境中追求相似目标——尤其是成功的战争准备——的统治者，通过与其环境中主要社会阶级结成独特的关系来回应这些环境。统治者与被统治者关系的重塑，产生了新的、对照鲜明的政府形式，每一种都或多或少适应其社会环境。

Those were the broad trends. Yet more than one combination of capital and coercion appeared at each stage in the growth of European states. We might distinguish a coercion-intensive, a capital-intensive, and a capitalized coercion path to state formation. They do not represent alternative "strategies" so much as contrasting conditions of life. Rulers pursuing similar ends - especially successful preparation for war - in very different environments responded to those environments by fashioning distinctive relations to the major social classes within them. The reshaping of relations between ruler and ruled produced new, contrasting forms of government, each more or less adapted to its social setting.
在强制密集型模式中，统治者从自己的人口及其征服的其他人那里榨取战争手段，在此过程中建立庞大的抽取结构。勃兰登堡和俄国——尤其是在其作为征收贡赋帝国的阶段——说明了强制密集型模式。然而，在这一模式的极端，武装地主掌握如此大的权力，以至于他们中没有人能对其他人建立持久控制；几个世纪里，波兰和匈牙利的贵族实际上自行选举国王，并在他们过于用力谋求最高权力时将其推翻。
In the
coercion-intensive

mode, rulers squeezed the means of war from their own populations and others they conquered, building massive structures of extraction in the process. Brandenburg and Russia - especially in their phases as tribute-taking empires - illustrate the coercion-intensive mode. At the very extreme of the mode, however, armed landlords wielded so much power that no one of them could establish durable control over the rest; for several centuries, the Polish and Hungarian nobilities actually elected their own kings, and struck them down when they strove too hard for supreme power.

在资本密集型模式中，统治者依靠与资本家的契约——他们悉心服务于资本家的利益——来租用或购买军事力量，从而进行战争而无需建立庞大的永久性国家结构。城邦、城市帝国、城市联盟以及其他主权碎裂的形式，通常属于这条变化路径。热那亚、杜布罗夫尼克、荷兰共和国，以及一度还有加泰罗尼亚，都是资本密集型模式的例证。正如荷兰共和国的历史所显示的，在极端情况下，这一模式产生了由大体自治的城邦组成的联盟，以及它们之间围绕国家政策的持续谈判。
In the
capital-intensive

mode, rulers relied on compacts with capitalists - whose interests they served with care - to rent or purchase military force, and thereby warred without building vast permanent state structures. City-states, city-empires, urban federations, and other forms of fragmented sovereignty commonly fall into this path of change. Genoa, Dubrovnik, the Dutch Republic, and, for a time, Catalonia, exemplify the capital-intensive mode. As the history of the Dutch Republic illustrates, at the extreme this mode produced federations of largely autonomous city-states, and constant negotiation among them over state policy.
在居间的资本化强制模式中，统治者两者各做一些，但比其资本密集型的邻国花费更多精力，把资本家和资本来源直接纳入其国家结构。资本与强制的持有者在相对平等的条件下互动。法国和英国最终走的是资本化强制模式，这一模式比强制密集型和资本密集型模式更早产生成熟的民族国家。
In the intermediate
capitalized coercion

mode, rulers did some of each, but spent more of their effort than did their capital-intensive neighbors on incorporating capitalists and sources of capital directly into the structures of their states. Holders of capital and coercion interacted on terms of relative equality. France and England eventually followed the capitalized coercion mode, which produced full-fledged national states earlier than the coercion-intensive and capital-intensive modes did.

在国际竞争的压力（尤其是战争和战争准备）驱动下，三条路径最终都汇聚于资本和强制的集中，其程度与公元990年时通行的情形完全不成比例。从17世纪起，资本化强制形式在战争中证明更为有效，从而为起源于其他强制与资本组合的国家提供了一个有说服力的样板。此外，从19世纪到最近过去，所有欧洲国家都比以往更重地介入建设社会基础设施、提供服务、规制经济活动、控制人口流动和保障公民福利；所有这些活动起初都是统治者努力从其臣民人口获取岁入与服从的副产品，但后来获得了自己的生命和理由。当代社会主义国家平均而言与资本主义国家的不同之处，在于对生产和分配施加更直接、更自觉的控制。然而，与过去一千年欧洲存在过的国家范围相比，它们仍可辨认地属于与其资本主义邻国相同的类型。它们也是民族国家。

Driven by the pressures of international competition (especially by war and preparation for war) all three paths eventually converged on concentrations of capital and of coercion out of all proportion to those that prevailed in AD 990. From the seventeenth century onward the capitalized coercion form proved more effective in war, and therefore provided a compelling model for states that had originated in other combinations of coercion and capital. From the nineteenth century to the recent past, furthermore, all European states involved themselves much more heavily than before in building social infrastructure, in providing services, in regulating economic activity, in controlling population movements, and in assuring citizens' welfare; all these activities began as byproducts of rulers' efforts to acquire revenues and compliance from their subject populations, but took on lives and rationales of their own. Contemporary socialist states differ from capitalist states, on the average, in exerting more direct, self-conscious control over production and distribution. As compared with the range of states that have existed in Europe over the last thousand years, nevertheless, they belong recognizably to the same type as their capitalist neighbors. They, too, are national states.
在最近这次汇聚之前，强制密集型、资本密集型和资本化强制路径导致了非常不同的国家种类。即便在汇聚之后，国家仍保留了一些明显反映其更早历史经验的特征——例如其代议机构的性质。在以往欧洲不同时期确实存在过的某些条件下，所有三种国家类型都相当可行。事实上，在1555年查理五世退位时，欧洲的大部分处于帝国霸权之下，而不是处于该词任何强意义上的民族国家的控制之下。

Before their recent convergence, the coercion-intensive, capital-intensive and capitalized coercion paths led to very different kinds of states. Even after convergence, states retained some features - for example, the character of their representative institutions -that clearly reflected their earlier historical experiences. All three types of state were quite viable under certain conditions that actually prevailed in Europe at various times before the present. Indeed, at the abdication of Charles V in 1555, the major part of Europe lay under imperial hegemony, rather than under the control of national states in any strong sense of the term.

在那一时点，苏莱曼大帝的奥斯曼帝国（除支配安纳托利亚和中东大部分地区外）占据巴尔干的大部分，并使从伏尔加到亚得里亚海之间的国家处于附庸地位。查理五世作为神圣罗马帝国皇帝、西班牙皇帝和哈布斯堡家族的家长，当时声称统治西班牙、尼德兰、米兰、那不勒斯、西西里、撒丁、奥地利、波希米亚、勃艮第、弗朗什—孔泰以及（更具争议地）我们现在称为德国的那片领土上的众多国家。更东边，波兰、立陶宛、莫斯科公国和顿河哥萨克也以帝国风格组织起来。1555年，意大利北部、瑞士以及神圣罗马帝国的重要部分仍是主权剧烈碎裂的地区，而只有法国和英国类似于我们关于民族国家的传统模型。到那时，城邦和其他小规模组织相对于其他形式的国家正在失去阵地。然而，荷兰共和国很快就将证明，城市与相邻领土的联盟仍然能够作为世界强国立足。此外，帝国正在推进。当时没有什么能保证民族国家的最终胜利。

At that point, Suleyman the Magnificent's Ottoman Empire (in addition to dominating Anatolia and much of the Middle East) occupied most of the Balkans and held in vassalage states from the Volga to the Adriatic. Charles V, as Holy Roman Emperor, Emperor of Spain, and Elder of the Habsburgs, then claimed rule over Spain, the Netherlands, Milan, Naples, Sicily, Sardinia, Austria, Bohemia, Burgundy, Franche-Comte and (more contestably) the swarm of states in the territory we now call Germany. Further east, Poland, Lithuania, Muscovy, and the Don Cossacks also organized in imperial style. In 1555, northern Italy, Switzerland, and significant parts of the Holy Roman Empire remained areas of intensely fragmented sovereignty, while only France and England resembled our conventional models of national states. By that time, city-states and other small-scale organizations were losing ground relative to other forms of state. Yet the Dutch Republic was soon to prove that federations of cities and adjacent territories could still hold their own as world powers. Empires, furthermore, were advancing. Nothing then assured the ultimate victory of the national state.
教训很清楚。用20世纪的实力作为有效国家形成的主要标准（许多分析者正是这样做的），意味着屈服于目的论的诱惑，错误地理解欧洲过去城市、国家、资本和强制之间的关系。我们可以通过从早期——这里任意设为公元990年——向现在追踪国家制造者的选择及其后果，来避免这些陷阱。

The lesson is clear. To use twentieth-century strength as the main criterion of effective state formation (as many analysts do) means succumbing to the temptations of teleology, misconceiving the relations among cities, states, capital, and coercion in the European past. We can avoid these pitfalls by following the choices of statemakers, and the consequences of those choices, forward from an early date - here set arbitrarily at AD 990 - to the present.
这种按时间顺序向前追踪的策略将使我们能够对本书的关键问题得出一些暂定的答案：如何解释自公元990年以来欧洲盛行的国家类型在时间与空间上的巨大差异，以及为什么欧洲国家最终汇聚于民族国家的不同变体？尽管这一问题极其宽泛，它可以转化为更狭窄、更易处理的问题，例如：
That forward-looking strategy will allow us to reach some tentative answers to this book's crucial question:
What accounts for the great variation over time and space in the kinds of states that have prevailed in Europe since
AD
990, and
why
did European states eventually converge on different variants of the national state?
Although the question is formidably broad, it translates into narrower, more manageable problems such as:
如何解释欧洲整体上大致呈同心圆状的国家形成格局：像奥斯曼帝国和莫斯科公国这样幅员辽阔但控制薄弱的国家较早在外围形成，法国和勃兰登堡这样较小但治理更紧密的国家组成大致居中的中间地带，而城邦、公国、联盟以及其他主权剧烈碎裂的变体构成中央地带，直到1790年以后才整合为更大的国家？
What accounts for the roughly concentric pattern of state formation in Europe as

a whole, with large but thinly-controlled states as the Ottoman Empire and Muscovy forming early around the periphery, smaller but more tightly governed states such as France and Brandenburg grouped in a rough intermediate zone, and a central band of city-states, principalities, federations, and other varieties of intensely fragmented sovereignty that only after 1790 consolidated into larger states?
为什么尽管有显而易见的相反利益，统治者仍常常接受在落入国家管辖的人口内建立代表主要阶级的机构？
Why, despite obvious interests to the contrary, did rulers frequently accept the
establishment of institutions representing the major classes within the populations that fell subject to the state's jurisdiction?
为什么欧洲国家在把城市寡头集团和城市机构纳入民族国家结构方面差别如此之大：荷兰共和国的国家实际上与其城市政府集群难以区分，波兰国家几乎对城市机构视而不见，而在这两个极端之间还有十几种其他变体？
Why did European states vary

so much with respect to the incorporation of urban oligarchies and institutions into national state structure, with the Dutch Republic's state practically indistinguishable from its cluster of municipal governments, the Polish state almost oblivious to urban institutions, and a dozen other variants in between those extremes?
为什么政治和商业权力从地中海的城邦和城市帝国滑向大西洋的规模可观的国家和相对从属的城市？
Why did political and commercial power slide from the city-states and city-empires of the Mediterranean to the substantial states and relatively subordinated cities of the Atlantic?
为什么城邦、城市帝国、联盟和宗教组织作为欧洲盛行的国家类型丧失了重要性？
Why did city-states, city-empires, federations, and religious organizations lose their importance as prevailing kinds of state in Europe?
为什么战争从为贡赋而征服、武装贡赋征收者之间的斗争，转变为大规模集结的陆军和海军之间的持久战役？
Why did war shift from conquest for tribute and struggle among armed tribute-takers to sustained battles among massed armies and navies?
这些问题仍然很大，但不像要求对欧洲国家所走替代轨迹作一般性解释那样大。因此，挑战在于通过仔细考察公元990年以后国家在欧洲不同地区实际走过的各种路径，来处理这个巨大的问题及其更易处理的子问题。这将涉及识别改变国家的主要过程，并把它们区分为强制密集型、资本密集型和资本化强制的变体。

The questions remain large, but not so large as the demand for a general explanation of the alternative trajectories taken by European states. The challenge, then, is to address this huge problem and its more manageable subsidiaries by close examination of the various paths that states actually took in different parts of Europe after AD 990. That will involve identifying the main processes transforming states, and sorting them out into their coercion-intensive, capital-intensive, and capitalized-coercion variants.

一本讨论这些问题的书必须在随机性与目的论之间走一条窄路。一边是随机性的死墙，在那里每段历史似乎都自成一格，一个国王或一场战役接着另一个。另一边是目的论的裂隙，在那里国家形成的结果似乎解释了它的全部过程。我将努力避开死墙和裂隙，办法是指出：国家形成的路径是多样的，但不是无限的；在任何特定历史关头，都有若干明显不同的未来是可能的；国家、统治者和公民深刻地相互影响；系统性的问题与过程把欧洲所有国家的历史连接起来，从而也把它们之间的关系连接起来。如果成功，接下来的各章将讲述一个多样中之统一、统一中之多样、选择与后果的故事。
A book on these questions must steer a narrow road between randomness and teleology. On one side, the blank wall of randomness, in which every history seems
sui generis,

one king or battle after another. On the other, the crevasse of teleology, in which the outcome of state formation seems to explain its entire course. I will try to avoid the blank wall and the crevasse by pointing out that the paths of state formation were multiple but not infinite, that at any particular historical juncture several distinctly different futures were possible, that states, rulers, and citizens influenced each other profoundly, that systematic problems and processes connected the histories of all European states, hence the relations among them. If successful, the chapters to come will tell a tale of diversity in unity, of unity in diversity, of choice and consequences.
让我立刻承认：我对欧洲过去的解读是非正统的、未经证明的，而且布满缺口。总体而言，欧洲国家的研究者一直谨慎地避免千年规模的综合。那些已经跃身一试的人，一般或者试图解释整个西方独特之处，或者提出一条单一的标准国家形成路径，或者两者兼有。他们通常以回溯的方式推进，寻找我们如今所知德国或西班牙这些国家的起源，而忽视沿途消失的国家，而不是试图描绘国家形成的全部范围。

Let me confess at once: my reading of the European past is unconventional, unproved, and riven with gaps. On the whole, students of European states have prudently avoided syntheses on the scale of a thousand years. Those who have made the leap have generally either sought to explain what was distinctive about the West as a whole, or proposed a single standard path of state formation, or both. They have usually proceeded retrospectively, seeking the origins of the states we now know as Germany or Spain and ignoring states that disappeared along the way rather than trying to chart the whole range of state formation.
通过主张存在多条路径，而这些路径是资本与强制集中难易程度的函数；通过论证国家形式与其先前获取资本的机会之间存在强烈的相互依赖；通过试图用按时间顺序向前追踪的分析，取代对国家结构转型的回溯性分析，我放弃了既有学术的稳妥之路，转而进行重思过去的冒险。此外，用两百来页讨论一千年，我只能希望指出一些重要的关系，并说明它们如何起作用。

By claiming the existence of multiple paths as a function of the relative ease with which capital and coercion concentrated, in arguing a strong interdependence between the form of a state and its previous access to capital, and by seeking to replace a retrospective with a prospective analysis of transformations in state structure I am abandoning the solid ways of established scholarship for an adventure in rethinking the past. By discussing a thousand years in little more than two hundred pages, furthermore, I can hope to do no more than identify some important relationships, and illustrate how they worked.

本书论证的充分展开版本会远比以下各页更加重视欧洲经济的动力。首先，我会对价格、生产率、贸易和人口增长的波动说得太少；除其他方面外，还会忽视13世纪、16世纪和18世纪的价格上涨以及其间的萧条，对不同类型的国家是否可行以及对商人、农民、地主、官员和其他社会阶级的相对权力所具有的可能的重大意义（Abel 1966, Frank 1978, Kriedte 1983, Wallerstein 1974-88）。

A fully expanded version of the book's argument would give far greater weight to the dynamics of the European economy than the following pages do. First of all, I will say far too little about swings in prices, productivity, trade and population growth, neglecting among other things the probable importance of price rises in the thirteenth, sixteenth, and eighteenth centuries and of depressions in between for the viability of different kinds of states and the relative power of merchants, peasants, landlords, officials, and other social classes (Abel 1966, Frank 1978, Kriedte 1983, Wallerstein 1974-88).

其次，我只会简略地处理生产组织的变化及由此产生的阶级结构。这并不是因为我认为它无关紧要。恰恰相反：地主与耕作者之间的关系对国家制造、保护和抽取的后果造成了巨大差异，匈牙利、佛罗伦萨和英国之间的对比立刻就能证明这一点。例如，17世纪的普鲁士国家带有普鲁士更早历史的印记：在13和14世纪，一个十字军修会——条顿骑士团——把军事控制扩展到那个人口稀少的地区，征服了先前占据该地的斯拉夫人，招引德意志骑士前来组织大庄园，并鼓励耕作，办法是让这些骑士招募农民去开垦和耕种将归农民自己所有的土地，以换取租赋和劳役。家户、村庄或地区层面的这类安排，明显影响了不同种类征税、征兵和监控的可行性。但我的任务已经够复杂了。为了集中讨论国家形成的机制，我会一再地把地主、农民、农业无产者和其他主要乡村行动者之间的关系加以刻板化或视为理所当然。

Second, I will treat the changing organization of production and the resulting class structure only cursorily. That is not because I think it negligible. On the contrary: relations between landlords and cultivators made an enormous difference to the consequences of statemaking, protection, and extraction, as contrasts among Hungary, Florence, and England instantly demonstrate. The seventeenth-century Prussian state, for example, bore the marks of Prussia's earlier history: during the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries a crusading order, the Teutonic Knights, extended military control over that thinly-settled region, subdued the Slavs who had previously occupied it, induced German knights to come in and organize large estates, and encouraged cultivation by those knights' recruitment of peasants to clear and farm land that would be theirs in return for dues and service. Such arrangements at the level of household, village, or region clearly affected the viability of different kinds of taxation, conscription, and surveillance. But my assignment is already complicated enough. In order to concentrate on mechanisms of state formation I will repeatedly stereotype or take for granted the relations among landlords, peasants, agricultural proletarians, and other major rural actors.

此外，在试图逼近关键关系时，我不会努力回顾过去或现在关于国家形成的替代理论。我也不会试图陈述本书组织性观念的谱系。卡尔·马克思、马克斯·韦伯、约瑟夫·熊彼特、斯坦·罗坎、巴林顿·摩尔、加布里埃尔·阿尔当等人显然已有与本书主题相关的分析，我们不妨略去介绍；行家们肯定会注意到它们在几乎每一页上的影响，而评论者无疑会浪费许多笔墨，试图把本书归入这个或那个学派。同时处理这些分析、其背后的理论以及国家形成这一历史现象，会削弱分析、使篇幅加倍，却不会使它有多大推进。相反，本书将聚焦于国家形成的实际过程。

In attempting to close in on the crucial relationships, furthermore, I will make no effort to review alternative theories of state formation, past or present. Nor will I try to state the pedigrees of the book's organizing ideas. Let us take for granted the existence of analyses by Karl Marx, Max Weber, Joseph Schumpeter, Stein Rokkan, Barrington Moore, Gabriel Ardant, and others that obviously bear on the book's subject matter;
cognoscenti

will surely notice their influence on almost every page, and reviewers will no doubt waste many of their words trying to pigeonhole the book into one school or another. To deal with those analyses, the theories behind them, and the historical phenomenon of state formation at the same time would blunt the analysis and double its length without advancing it greatly. Instead, the book will focus on the actual processes of state formation.

为了紧凑呈现，我同样会一页又一页地诉诸转喻和实体化。转喻在于，我会一再谈到“统治者”“国王”和“君主”，仿佛他们代表了一个国家的整个决策机构，从而把一组复杂、偶然的社会关系化约为单一的点。转喻还在于，城市实际上代表的是以大型聚落为焦点的区域生产与贸易网络。实体化在于，我会一次又一次地把统一的利益、理由、能力和行动归给一个国家、一个统治阶级或受其共同控制的人民。若没有一个使用转喻和实体化的简化模型，我们就无望识别欧洲国家形成复杂过程中的主要联系。

In the interests of compact presentation, I will likewise resort to metonymy and reification on page after page. Metonymy, in that I will repeatedly speak of "rulers," "kings," and "sovereigns" as if they represented a state's entire decision-making apparatus, thus reducing to a single point a complex, contingent set of social relations. Metonymy, in that cities actually stand for regional networks of production and trade in which the large settlements are focal points. Reification, in that I will time and again impute a unitary interest, rationale, capacity, and action to a state, a ruling class, or the people subject to their joint control. Without a simplifying model employing metonymy and reification, we have no hope of identifying the main connections in the complex process of European state formation.

大多数时候，这一隐含模型将包含这些要素：一位统治者，他概括了国家最有权势官员的联合决策；一个统治阶级，与统治者结盟并在国家管辖下的领土内控制主要生产资料；其他依附者，从与国家的关系中享有特殊好处；国家、其统治者、其统治阶级及其依附者在国家自身区域内外两方面的对手、敌人和竞争者；落入国家管辖的其余人口；一个强制机器，包括在国家控制下运作的陆军、海军和其他有组织的集中化武力手段；以及国家的文官机构，尤其由在其控制下运作的独特的财政、行政和司法组织构成。
Most of the time the implicit model will contain these elements: a
ruler
summing up the joint decision-making of a state's most powerful officers; a
ruling class
allied with the ruler and controlling major means of production within the territory under the state's jurisdiction; other
clients
enjoying special benefits from their association with the state;
opponents, enemies, and rivals
of the state, its ruler, its ruling class, and its clients, both within and outside the state's own area; the remainder of the
population
falling under the state's jurisdiction; a
coercive apparatus
including armies, navies, and other organized, concentrated means of force that operate under the state's control; and the
civilian apparatus
of the state, consisting especially of distinctive fiscal, administrative, and judicial organizations that operate under its control.

接下来大多数论证都涉及描述和解释自公元990年以来欧洲历史中统治者、统治阶级、依附者、对手、一般人口、强制组织和民政管理机构相互联结的不同方式。偶尔它们会拆解这些实体化范畴中的某一个——最显著的是具体说明资本家（当然，他们本身就是一个实体化的类别）在何时、为何以及产生何种效果地落入这些范畴中的某一个。但通常论证的进行仿佛每个范畴都是真实的、单一的和不成问题的。这是我们在大陆与千年的尺度上运作所付出的代价。

Most of the arguments to come entail the description and explanation of the different ways that rulers, ruling classes, clients, opponents, general populations, coercive organizations, and civil administrations articulated in European history from AD 990 onward. Occasionally they unpack one or another of these reified categories - most notably by specifying when, why, and with what effects capitalists (themselves, to be sure, a reified class of people) fell into one or another of the categories. But usually the arguments proceed as if each category were real, unitary and unproblematic. We pay that price for operating on the scale of a continent and a thousand years.

最后一点致歉。在这样大的尺度上，我必须像打水漂的石子那样处理历史事实：迅速从一个高点旋到另一个高点，而每次停留不超过一瞬。我并不掌握充分撰写本书所需的全部历史，而为我自认为掌握的历史提供全部文献依据，会使正文不堪重负。例如，关于国家活动最近的扩张，任何负责任的作者都会想要引用莱因哈德·本迪克斯、沃尔特·科尔皮、西达·斯科奇波尔、约兰·瑟博恩以及更多人。我完全不做这种事，一般只把引注保留给直接引文和冷僻或有争议的信息。显然，专家们将不得不细致审视我对欧洲历史的呈现，并思考其错误是否损害了其论证。

A final apology. On such a scale, I must deal with historical facts like a rock skipping water; spinning quickly from high point to high point without settling for more than an instant at a time. I do not know all the history one would need to write this book fully, and to supply all the documentation for the history I think I do know would burden the text immeasurably. On the recent growth of state activity, for example, any responsible author would want to cite Reinhard Bendix, Walter Korpi, Theda Skocpol, Goran Therborn, and many more. I do nothing of the sort, generally reserving citations for direct quotations and esoteric or controversial information. Clearly, experts will have to scrutinize my rendering of European histories, and ponder whether its errors vitiate its arguments.
鉴于其宽泛、综合和思辨的性质，本书的论证难以直接加以证实或证伪。然而，以下情况在多大程度上成立，我们就可以在多大程度上判断这些论证有误：
Given their broad, synthetic, and speculative character, this book's arguments do not lend themselves immediately to verification or refutation. Yet we can judge them wrong to the degree that:
与资本和强制关系极为不同的统治者，在试图建立武装力量和国家权力时，仍追求相似的策略并产生相似的效果；
rulers having very different relations to capital and coercion nevertheless pursued similar strategies, with similar effects, when they tried to build armed force and state power;
特定国家以及整个欧洲国家体系成长与转型的重大时刻，并不对应于战争和战争准备；
major moments in the growth and transformation of particular states, and of the European state system as a whole, did
not
correspond to war and preparation for war;
积聚武装力量手段的努力，并未产生国家结构的持久特征；
efforts to amass the means of armed force did
not
produce durable features of state structure;
统治者刻意按预想的蓝图建构国家，并成功地遵循了那些蓝图；
rulers deliberately set out to construct states according to preconceived designs, and succeeded in following those designs;
我所声称的某些或全部经验规律性——尤其是（a）国家形成的空间格局，（b）城市寡头和机构被以不同方式纳入民族国家结构，（c）尽管统治者有相反利益，代议机构仍得以发展，（d）政治和商业权力从地中海向大西洋的移动，（e）城邦、城市帝国、联盟和宗教组织的衰落，以及（f）战争转向大规模集结的陆军和海军之间的持久战役——事实上经不起历史审视；

some or all of the empirical regularities I have claimed - especially (a) state formation's geography, (b) differential incorporation of urban oligarchies and institutions into national state structure, (c) development of representative institutions despite rulers' contrary interests, (d) movement of political and commercial power from Mediterranean to Atlantic, (e) decline of city-states, city-empires, federations, and religious organizations, and (f) shift of war to sustained battles among massed armies and navies - do not, in fact, hold up to historical scrutiny;
替代性解释对那些确实经得起审视的经验规律性提供了更为简约或更有说服力、或兼具两者的论述。
alternative explanations provide more economical and/or convincing accounts of those empirical regularities that
do
hold up to scrutiny.
如果其中任何一条成立，我的论证就面临严重挑战。如果所有都成立，它就显然错误。
If any of these holds true, my argument faces a serious challenge. If all of them hold true, it is clearly wrong.

这关涉重大的理论问题。例如，人们可以预期约瑟夫·斯特雷耶的追随者会认为，君主的国内缔造和平活动开始得早得多，在人们接受国家方面所起的作用也远大于我的论述所暗示的，因此会支持清单中对本书分析的大部分指控。人们可以预期道格拉斯·诺思的追随者会声称，国家对产权的界定与保护构成了我归因于战争准备的许多变化的基础。人们可以预期伊曼纽尔·沃勒斯坦的追随者会坚持认为，国家的活动推进资本家利益的程度远大于我在论述中所承认的，而佩里·安德森的追随者会反驳（至少对我分析的中段而言）说，这一论证大大低估了欧洲贵族在创建庞大的“绝对主义”国家中的分量。因此，我的论证在哪些方面正确、哪些方面错误，关涉到关于欧洲国家形成的一些被广泛讨论的分歧。

Important theoretical issues are at stake. One might expect a follower of Joseph Strayer, for example, to hold that the domestic peacemaking activities of monarchs began much earlier and played a much larger part in people's acceptance of the state than my account implies, and therefore to uphold most of the checklist's charges against the book's analysis. One might expect a follower of Douglass North to claim that the state's construction and protection of property rights underlay many of the changes I have attributed to preparation for war. One might expect a follower of Immanuel Wallerstein to insist that the activities of states forwarded the interests of capitalists to an even larger degree than I have allowed, and a follower of Perry Anderson to counter (at least for the middle period of my analysis) that the argument greatly underestimates the weight of European nobilities in the creation of bulky "absolutist" states. Thus the ways in which my arguments are right or wrong bear on widely-discussed disagreements concerning European state formation.
这份清单提供了一种手段，把对本书可能的批评分为正当的、半正当的和不正当的。若能确认刚刚列出的某一条件，或本书论证所隐含的类似条件，确实适用于欧洲经验中相当大的一部分，那将是完全正当且很有启发性的。若能表明这一论证未能解释特定国家某些重大的、持久的特征，那将是半正当的。（这一标准只能是半正当的，因为那将表明论证不完整——这一点我预先欣然承认——但不会表明它是错的。）

The checklist provides a means of sorting possible criticisms of the book into legitimate, semi-legitimate, and illegitimate. It would be fully legitimate, and quite illuminating, to establish that one of the conditions just listed, or a similar condition implied by the book's arguments did, indeed, hold for some substantial block of European experience. It would be semi-legitimate to show that the argument did not account for certain major, durable features of particular states. (The criterion would be only semi-legitimate because it would show that the argument was incomplete - which I concede readily in advance - but not that it was wrong.)
若抱怨论证忽视了批评者恰好认为重要的变量——物理环境、意识形态、军事技术或其他什么——那将是不正当的。“缺失变量”批评只有在批评者表明忽视该变量导致对论证中确实出现的变量之间关系的错误解读时，才变得正当。要点不在于给出一个“完整”的论述（无论那是什么），而在于把主要联系弄对。

It would be illegitimate to complain that the argument neglects variables the critic happens to regard as important: physical environment, ideology, military technology, or something else. The missing-variable criticism only becomes legitimate when the critic shows that neglect of the variable causes a false reading of relationships among variables that
do
appear in the argument. The point is not to give a "complete" account (whatever that might be), but to get the main connections right.

为追求这一目标，下一章集中讨论这一探究所涉千年间欧洲城市与国家不断变化的地理格局；第3章接着讨论国家统治者获取从事其主要活动——尤其是武装力量的创造——所需手段的机制，以及这些机制对国家结构的意涵。第4章集中讨论国家与公民之间的关系，追踪庞大的多功能国家如何通过讨价还价而形成。第5章处理国家形成的替代路径，追踪与资本和强制关系的变化所产生的效果。第6章把欧洲国家作为一个相互作用的各方所组成的集合来考察，这个体系的运作约束着其成员的行动。第7章把故事讲到当代，反思资本与强制在当代的关系，力求理解为什么第二次世界大战以来军人在如此多的国家中获得了权力，并希望辨识欧洲经验以何种方式帮助我们理解我们自己时代陷入困境的国家。

In pursuit of that goal, the next chapter concentrates on the changing geography of cities and states in Europe over the inquiry's thousand years. Chapter 3 takes up the mechanisms by which the rulers of states acquired the means to carry on their major activities - especially the creation of armed force - and the implications of those mechanisms for state structure. Chapter 4 concentrates on relations between states and citizens, tracing the formation through bargaining of massive, multi-function states. Chapter 5 deals with alternative paths of state formation, tracing out the effects of varying relationships to capital and coercion. Chapter 6 examines European states as a set of interacting parties, a system whose operation constrains the actions of its members. Chapter 7 brings the story up to the present, reflecting on contemporary relationships between capital and coercion in an effort to understand why military men have gained power in so many states since World War II, and in the hope of discerning in what ways European experience helps us understand the troubled states of our own time.

zh: 本稿用“民族国家”译 national state，指以集权、分化而自主的结构治理多个相邻地区及其城市的国家；用“国民国家”译 nation-state，指其人民共享强烈的语言、宗教和象征认同的国家。这是作者有意作出的概念区分，二者不可互换。
